body.x: Sony Corporation unveiled the latest lineup of innovative technologies at the global consumer electronics show 'CES 2018' held in Las Vegas, Nevada on January 9 (local time).

The Sony booth at the CES 2018, provides 4K OLED TVs with a completely immersive experience, and wireless noise-canceling earbuds for listening to high-quality music anytime, anywhere. Moreover, it displays latest new products that it has been developed such as a new automotive image sensor which will help for the fully autonomous driving and an entertainment robot dog aibo™ which adapts to AI x robotics technology. Mainly, robot dog Aibo is the first overseas debut since it was announced in Japan in November last year.

Hirai Kazuo, Sony president and CEO, said at the press conference on January 8, ahead of official CES 2018 launch, "There is still a lot of work Sony can do in consumer electronics innovations, I believe we can bring about a more meaningful creative and entertainment experience.”

Sony releases the new 4K OLED BRAVIA® A8F series equipped with the 4K HDR image processor 'X1 ™ Extreme'. The 4K OLED BRAVIA A8F series are equipped with Acoustic Surface (TM) technology making sound through the screen vibrations of the A1 series, which drew much attention last year. They introduce a new design that minimizes the space occupation and can be installed various places. The A8F series provide an amazing immersive experiences with Sony's unique screen and audio technology.

Newly introduced BRAVIA 4K LCD TV X900F series is also equipped with the X1 Extreme processor. In particular, controlling the image precisely by the new X-Motion Clarity technology, we can minimize blur and enable fast action scenes to be cleared naturally. We can enjoy action movies and various sports games without blur even on large 85-inch screens with this new technology.

Moreover, Sony unveiled the world's first fully wireless earbuds, the WF-SP700N, equipped with noise-canceling and IPX4 rated waterproofing technology together. The noise-canceling technology allows you to enjoy your music without disturbing outside noise while you exercise, and gives waterproof function to have your outdoor sports activities without worrying about sweat or rain. Besides, using Ambient Sound mode, with quick notice, you can handle the dangerous situation that may occur in the outdoor activities while exercising. The WI-SP600N, wireless noise canceling earphone with neckband type, will also be released.

The increasing number of devices with voice recognition is one of the catching features at this year's CES 2018 Sony booth. In addition to the newly released WF-SP700N and WI-SP600N, the Noise-Canceling Headset 1000X series, which drew much attention last year, is also equipped with the Google Assistant, Google’s AI voice recognition application.
As the Sony products, equipped with the Google assistant, increases, we can enjoy a smart life using the Google assistant at home and on the road.
